perspective: Security engineer discovering these artifacts on an endpoint
method: atomscan --no-update --analyze local --mode slow --follow=none --format=json on all 87 artifacts plus the official Node reference.
Final affected-sample rescans on the completed trait snapshot: the six endpoint artifacts, six manifest exfiltration samples, the official Node reference and the destructured-DNS regression archive.
Inspected source call/receiver provenance with cleave facts and compared observed claims against the matchers.
Kept earlier concurrent Java/Python/PNG changes outside the isolated review snapshot.

changes.subject: OOB GET requests
changes.fix: Use imported HTTP-client receiver provenance, module-level call facts and a complete resolved destination URL. Covers renamed aliases, var/let, node: imports, inline require and calls without event handlers; rejects unrelated or overwritten clients and collector strings that are not request targets.

changes.subject: HTTP GET capability
changes.fix: Require a real http/https import instead of assuming any client.get() method is HTTP.

changes.subject: DNS operations
changes.fix: Replace nearby require/resolve text with imported-receiver provenance; add a same-body binding query for destructured require aliases with reassignment controls. Distinguish a variable argument from proof of computed/exfiltrated data; consolidate inline-require variants and update dependent rules.

changes.subject: Mythic operator UI
changes.fix: Accept gql tags renamed through actual Apollo import aliases; preserve rejection of quoted source and unrelated helper imports.

changes.subject: Package activation claims
changes.fix: Describe the contained shell loader and OOB beacon separately from manifest declarations. Package scope alone does not bind either operation to preinstall or main.

changes.subject: Install-hook exfiltration
changes.fix: Separate ordinary URL substitution from transfer commands carrying host/account/directory/environment output. Reject echo-only URLs, unrelated curl commands, ordinary platform/version downloads and literal single-quoted substitutions; retain true shell expansion after a quoted URL prefix.

changes.subject: Neutral curl declaration
changes.fix: Move a curl HTTP URL declaration from remote execution into package-command metadata. Keep curl-to-Node execution detection and its hostile composite.

changes.subject: Encrypted npm archives
changes.fix: Move encrypted-entry/npm-manifest co-occurrence from anti-static packing into archive metadata; preserve its matcher and notable severity without asserting concealment.

changes.subject: Node CLI options
changes.fix: Do not mistake node --version/--help output used in a download filename for running a disguised script. Keep the finding for a separate node stage.dat command in the same script.

changes.subject: Fixture interpretation
changes.fix: Move the direct module-level OAST HTTP GET control from notable to suspicious. It makes a real collector request even without host inventory.
